extDescription.message: Updates your progress in Cinepisode while you watch Netflix, and imports your Netflix history into the “Detected” tab.

lastNone.message: Nothing detected yet. An episode counts as watched at 80% or at the end credits, a movie at 90%.

lastInvalidToken.message: Invalid token: generate a new one in Cinepisode, then Settings › Token › Change.

lastNoToken.message: No token saved: $LABEL$ was not sent.

lastNetwork.message: Could not reach Cinepisode (connection?): $LABEL$ was not sent.

lastServerError.message: Cinepisode server error: $LABEL$ was not saved.

lastLegacyNoChange.message: No change for $LABEL$ (not in your list or already up to date).

importDone.message: $N$ titles sent ($NEW$ new, $UPD$ more recent). Choose what to add in Cinepisode's “Detected” tab.

importNothing.message: Nothing new since the last import.

importTruncated.message: Very long history: only the 20,000 most recent views were read.

importMetaFailed.message: Some episode numbers could not be read.

importErrNoToken.message: Connect the extension with your token first.

importErrToken.message: Invalid token: generate a new one in Cinepisode, then Settings › Token › Change.

importErrNetflixTab.message: Could not open Netflix in this browser.

importErrNetflixAuth.message: Sign in to Netflix in this browser (and pick your profile), then try again.

importErrNetflix.message: Netflix answered unexpectedly. Try again later, or import the CSV file.

importErrCsv.message: Unreadable file: pick NetflixViewingHistory.csv (20 MB max).

importErrLimit.message: Too many detected titles waiting: sort them out in Cinepisode's “Detected” tab.

importErrServer.message: Cinepisode server error. Try again later.

platformEnabled.message: Enabled: live detection and history import.

platformDenied.message: Access denied by Chrome: nothing was enabled.

importTruncatedOther.message: Very long history: only the most recent part was read.

importPartial.message: The oldest part of your history couldn't be read (Crunchyroll refused the rest): everything before it was sent. Run the import again later to retry.

importErrPermission.message: Turn the platform on first (its tile in the grid).

importErrCrunchyrollAuth.message: Crunchyroll does not recognise your session: sign in on www.crunchyroll.com in this browser, then try again.

importErrCrunchyroll.message: Crunchyroll answered unexpectedly. Try again later; if it happens again, copy the diagnostic below and send it to us.

importErrPrimeAuth.message: Sign in to www.primevideo.com in this browser (and pick your profile), then try again.

importErrPrime.message: Prime Video answered unexpectedly. Try again later.

importErrCrunchyrollBlocked.message: Crunchyroll (Cloudflare) blocked the request. Open www.crunchyroll.com in a tab, complete the check if one appears, then try again.

importErrCrunchyrollRate.message: Crunchyroll is limiting requests right now. Try again in a few minutes.

importErrCrunchyrollTab.message: Could not open www.crunchyroll.com in a tab. Open the site yourself, then try again.

importDiagCopied.message: Diagnostic copied (no token or password in it).

importDiagCopyFailed.message: Copy failed: select the diagnostic text by hand.

platformEnabledLive.message: Enabled: live detection (no history available on this platform).

diagCopied.message: Diagnostics copied: paste them in your message (no token included).

liveOnlyInfo.message: Disney+ and Apple TV don't give access to your watch history: only episodes you watch from now on are detected. To recover your past, request a copy of your data (Disney: account settings / Apple: privacy.apple.com).

connectedTitle.message: Token saved: detections go to your Cinepisode account

offHeroTitle.message: Link the extension to your account

offHeroSub.message: Your episodes tick themselves off while you watch.

offPrivacy.message: The token stays in this browser. Only the title, season and episode are sent to Cinepisode.

changeTokenFoot.message: Your current token stays active until you paste a new one.

idleSub.message: Start an episode on an active platform.

chipTip.message: Turn on $NAME$: Chrome will ask for access to this site

rulesCap.message: When a title counts as watched

rulesText.message: An episode at 80% or as soon as the end credits show, a movie at 90%, after at least 20 seconds of continuous playback. Titles found in your list are updated; the others go to the “Detected” tab.
